seoTitle: What Happens When You Block a Buyer on eBay
metaDescription: Find out what actually happens when you block a buyer on eBay, what they can no longer do, and how to use the Buyer Management page.
intro: Dealing with a problematic buyer is stressful, and it helps to know exactly what blocking them on eBay does and doesn't restrict before you rely on it. This guide explains how to block a buyer through eBay's Buyer Management page and what blocked users can and cannot still do on the platform.

steps.heading: Open the Buyer Management page
steps.body: Access this page from your eBay seller account to manage which buyers are restricted from interacting with your listings.

steps.heading: Add the buyer to your block list
steps.body: Enter the buyer's username to add them to your blocked list and restrict their activity on your listings.

steps.heading: Understand what blocking restricts
steps.body: Review what blocked buyers can and cannot do, such as purchasing your items or contacting you, since blocking has specific limits.

steps.heading: Use seller protection features
steps.body: Explore other seller protection tools available on eBay alongside blocking to further manage difficult buyer interactions.

faq.question: Can a blocked buyer still view my listings?
faq.answer: Blocking primarily restricts purchasing and contact ability; the guide walks through exactly what blocked users can and can't do.

faq.question: Does blocking a buyer protect my seller account?
faq.answer: It's one part of eBay's seller protection tools, useful for handling harassment, low feedback risk, or repeated cancellations.

faq.question: How do I block a buyer on eBay?
faq.answer: You use the Buyer Management page to add their username to your blocked list.

faq.question: Who benefits most from blocking buyers?
faq.answer: Power sellers, part-time sellers, or anyone managing high-volume listings who wants more control over buyer activity.
